cron.access_help: Shared endpoint and authentication used by every scheduled task.
cron.query_help: For URL-only hosting schedulers: HTTP Basic authentication, username scheduler, password equal to the cron token. HTTPS is required. GET runs the task; HEAD only checks availability.
cron.rotate_confirm: Rotate the cron token? Existing scheduled calls will stop working until they are updated.

tasks.cleanup_help: Maintains core data, caches, temporary files and completed update backups.
tasks.cleanup_schedule: Schedule hourly. Internal due checks prevent cleanup from running too often.

cron.run_failed: The task failed. See its result in the run history.

health.title: Site health
health.intro: Daily operational checks with a recorded result and a notification to every active administrator.
health.schedule: Schedule once a day. Every completed inspection notifies active administrators.
health.notification_ok: Site health inspection completed: everything is OK.
health.notification_attention: Site health inspection completed: something needs attention.

errors.configuration: A valid site URL is missing from configuration.
errors.response_limit: The response exceeded the size limit; the transfer is incomplete.

scheduler.stale: The last successful run is too old.
scheduler.unknown: This older report has no details. Run a new inspection.
